thread:
Sam Ortega: Quick rollcall — I’m doing the 22:00 UTC runtime deploy for v3.5.7. Pushing canary then 10min ramp. tagging owners: @Jen for smoke, @Alex for metrics, @Mike for rollback readiness.
Miguel Chen: LGTM from runtime side. Canary image built and pushed to prod-registry (sha: a1b2c3). No model changes.
Lia Gomez: ✅ I can be on standby for console/traffic toggles if needed.
Jen Park: I’ll run smoke after canary hits. Smoke checklist attached below.
Alex Zhao: I’ll watch p95 latency and token-cost dashboards. Ping me if error-rate > 1% or p50 jumps > 30ms.
Mike Lewis: Rollback owner here. If canary fails, I’ll trigger rollback lane and revert routing to previous variant. Make sure the rollback playbook lines up with the image id.
Sam Ortega: Timeline: 22:00 - push canary, 22:02 - run smoke, 22:12 - decision to ramp to 50%, 22:30 - full. Call timeout for rollback is 22:20 (if smoke or early metrics bad).
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: deploy/v3.5.7 -> canary (node-pool: runtime-canary). CI: all green.
Jen Park: Smoke commands:
```
# verify basic inference
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-v3.5","input":"The weather today"}'
# run perf probe (local)
./scripts/probe_latency.sh --target canary
```
Jen Park: Smoke checklist: 
- [x] basic generate ✅
- [x] health endpoints OK ✅
- [x] kv cache warming OK ✅
- [ ] 1k-token rolling test (running)
- [ ] auth header passthrough test

Miguel Chen: Running rolling 1k-token test now, will update in thread.
Sam Ortega: Lia, Alex — can you stand by for 22:10 decision? If everything green we ramp. If not, Mike will roll back.
Lia Gomez: Standing by. I’ll be ready to flip feature-flag if we need quick fallback.
Alex Zhao: Metrics dashboard pre-snapshot saved -> dashboard link https://kibana.redwood/view/abc123 (shareable).
Jen Park: Rolling 1k done, 0.9% error, median latency +12ms. auth passthrough test pending (quick check next).
Mike Lewis: If errors >1% or auth fails, I’ll roll back. I have `rollback.sh` ready.
Sam Ortega: Ok team — last call for objections? If none, proceeding at 22:00.
Lia Gomez: no objections from product infra. go ahead. :thumbsup:
Alex Zhao: +1
Miguel Chen: +1
Jen Park: smoke in final state, marking checklist: last two items done.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 100% of canary lane. Hooks triggered.
Sam Ortega: Ramping to 50% now. Watching metrics.
Alex Zhao: p50 +10ms, p95 +18ms, error-rate 0.7% — acceptable.
Mike Lewis: standing down for rollback.
Sam Ortega: Will finish full ramp at 22:30 unless anyone calls rollback before 22:20.
Jen Park: final smoke OK. Signing off. :white_check_mark:
Lia Gomez: Signed off for traffic ops.
Miguel Chen: Deploy looks clean from runtime.
Sam Ortega: Thanks everyone — closing thread after full ramp.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: v3.5.7 -> production (full). Release notes: https://changelog.redwood/v3.5.7
